tasks.description: The feCritique wave fragment measures the built UI (the build-phase gates, deterministic sub-scores, DOM-marked tiles at 1440x900 and 390x844), then runs at most rounds_max rounds (1 in small mode) of three fresh frontend-critic passes. An issue is kept only if two critics raise it or a deterministic check confirms it, at most five per round, each with a mark id, the measured problem and a concrete fix. A candidate replaces the best-so-far only when every gate still passes, no deterministic sub-score drops and it wins the pairwise comparison in both orders; otherwise the tree goes back to the best-so-far. It stops after two rejected candidates. Five blind frontend-probe readers per viewport must restate the brief's proposition (at least 4 of 5). The receipt is written to C:/x/qc/repo/.execution/frontend/critique/receipt.json and the rendered UI copy to C:/x/qc/repo/.execution/frontend/ui-copy.md for /prose.

params.estimate_basis: Multi-agent: per round about 25-40 min (measure, three critics in parallel, one fix, measure, two pairwise judges, probes after an accept), up to rounds_max rounds, stopping early when no issue is kept. Each agent stays under about 20 min, so /execution's 60 min single-agent sizing rule does not apply to the total; small mode runs one round. verify: /execution verify class plus the receipt check and the full --phase build run.

expect.summary: exit 0

negative_control.description: Set ok to false in C:/x/qc/repo/.execution/frontend/critique/receipt.json, or delete the file: the receipt check must exit 1.

tasks.title: Critique rounds and final gates

tasks.description: A fresh reviewer (plan as the contract, burden on done) compares HEAD with every approved requirement and records gaps; missing or partial work under an approved requirement becomes tasks through amend, anything wider a decision. The proof checks that the newest convergence result for HEAD has no missing or partial gap within scope.

expect.summary: the newest convergence result for HEAD has no missing or partial gap within the approved scope

negative_control.description: a forged reviewer result for HEAD with one missing gap must exit 1

tasks.title: Convergence pass for HEAD

tasks.description: Verifier agents replay the proof of every done task on HEAD of a fresh clone (exec.py proof run --by replay); this task's own proof checks that each done task has such a run for HEAD with its current proof hash and its expectation met (harden-ready H13).

expect.summary: every done task has a replay run of HEAD whose expectation is met

negative_control.description: a forged state copy where one replay run has expectation.met false must exit 1

tasks.title: Replay every proof on a fresh clone of HEAD

tasks.description: Run the generated completion check for the build phase from a clean clone with the gates.json install: every REQ gate, the TODO scan, never-show, the plan chain, the convergence pass, the harden-ready report for HEAD and the frontend build phase must be ok; a skipped gate is open.

expect.summary: every build-phase gate is ok (none skipped)

negative_control.description: the same command against a forged state copy where one REQ gate's receipt has verdict fail must exit 1

tasks.title: Build-complete gate

tasks.description: When harden-ready H7 lists env files that a framework would load automatically, the owner moves them out of the repository; the event profile loads them by path (policy.secrets.env_file). Agents never move, read or rename env files.

steps: Move each file harden-ready H7 listed out of the repository, for instance into C:/x/qc/private/env/; the event profile loads it by path (policy.secrets.env_file).
Reply « fait » once nothing is left; the orchestrator re-runs harden-ready --only H7.

expect.summary: the owner's answer is verified and harden-ready H7 is ok

negative_control.description: an owner action
negative_control.waived_reason: an owner action checked mechanically by harden-ready H7, which opens no file

spec.attest: the owner moved the listed files out of the repository (harden-ready H7 is the mechanical check)

tasks.title: Park auto-loaded env files outside the repository (owner)

tasks.description: After the hand-over the owner types /harden, reviews .harden/report.md, merges the branch it names into main and pushes; /harden never merges or pushes. The task is done when the merge SHA is on origin/main.

bring_back.description: the merge commit SHA on main

steps: Open a new session at the repository root and type the command the hand-over printed (/harden, with its paths and --profile when given).
Read .harden/report.md, merge the branch named in its header into main and push.
Reply with the merge commit SHA, then type /execution --fix <repo>/.harden/report.md.

expect.summary: the merge SHA is an ancestor of origin/main

negative_control.description: an owner action
negative_control.waived_reason: an owner action whose SHA is verified on origin/main by answers ingest

spec.attest: the owner merged the /harden branch; the SHA is on origin/main

tasks.title: Review and merge the /harden branch (owner)

tasks.description: The owner picks which /harden report items become fix tasks: none, the blocking ones, the recommended ones, or a list (FIX-MODE.md 4). Unselected items are recorded with the reason.

bring_back.description: none, blocking, recommended, or custom with the list

options.consequence: Le contrôle de non-régression tourne, puis les livrables (H3 d'abord).
options.label: Aucun correctif

options.consequence: Les éléments bloquants deviennent des tâches de correction, puis le contrôle de non-régression.
options.label: Corriger les éléments bloquants

options.consequence: Les éléments recommandés deviennent des tâches de correction, puis le contrôle de non-régression.
options.label: Corriger la sélection recommandée

options.consequence: Les identifiants que tu écris deviennent des tâches de correction.
options.label: Ma sélection

steps: Read the French summary of the /harden report (items to review, blocking ones, recommended ones).
Answer none, blocking, recommended, or your list (for example T2:H-007, REV:H-003=revert).

expect.summary: a resolution block of kind fix-selection with the owner's verbatim quote

negative_control.description: an owner decision
negative_control.waived_reason: an owner decision: the resolution block is the evidence, nothing to falsify by script

spec.attest: the owner resolved the fix-selection decision

tasks.title: Select the fixes after /harden (owner)

tasks.description: Run the completion check for the build and harden phases from a clean clone with the gates.json install: the build gates still pass, the harden-review task is done and every selected fix task is done. With no fix selected it runs as the placeholder gate. Deliverables and FE-21 wait for it.

expect.summary: every build and harden phase gate is ok (none skipped)

negative_control.description: the same command against a forged state copy where one fix task's receipt has verdict fail must exit 1

tasks.title: Regression gate after the fixes

tasks.description: At the code-for-recording freeze, check that no commit after the freeze instant touches **, so the recorded demo is the code that ships.

expect.summary: no commit after the freeze instant touches the frozen globs

negative_control.description: a forged commit dated after the freeze that touches a frozen glob must exit 1

tasks.title: Freeze the code for the recording

tasks.description: After /harden's review, the owner signs off the deployed preview at the size it will be recorded, before any recording task. A no reopens work as fix tasks; it is never recorded as a sign-off.

bring_back.description: signed off: yes, or no with a numbered list of changes, each naming the screen and what is wrong. The orchestrator writes it to C:/x/qc/repo/.execution/frontend/choices.json as H3 with the preview URL, the UTC time and the channel.

steps: On the laptop, open the deployed preview with ?record=1 in a browser window of 1536x864 CSS px at 125% zoom, the recording setup (FD20).
Walk the judge's path from the brief: the first screen, then every feature section; each shows its status label (live, testnet, simulated or planned) and its proof.
Read the latest gate report under C:/x/qc/repo/.execution/frontend/gates/ and the critique receipt C:/x/qc/repo/.execution/frontend/critique/receipt.json: every gate ok, none skipped, probes passed.
Check that nothing on the never-show list appears in images or frames (the gates checked the rendered text).
Sign off, or list what must change before anything is recorded.

params.estimate_basis: Owner minutes at the laptop: one walk through the judge's path at recording size; the best measured judges still trail humans by about 14 points (FD17-F07).

expect.summary: signed_off is true with an empty changes list, answered_at is UTC and channel is notion, remote-control, ask-user-question or terminal.

negative_control.description: An H3 with signed_off false and a numbered list of changes: the proof must fail and every recording task stay blocked.
negative_control.waived_reason: owner checkpoint: its file proof is evaluated by exec.py; /frontend's control: An H3 with signed_off false and a numbered list of changes: the proof must fail and every recording task stay blocked.

tasks.title: Sign off the deployed preview at recording size (H3, owner)

tasks.description: The owner records the demo at recording size after FE-21's sign-off, from the frozen code, within the event's length limit.

bring_back.description: absolute path of the video file

steps: Record the demo at recording size from the frozen code, within the length limit of the event.
Reply with the absolute path of the video file.

expect.summary: the video file exists at the path the owner gave

negative_control.description: an owner deliverable
negative_control.waived_reason: an owner deliverable whose file is checked by answers ingest (file-exists)

tasks.title: Record the demo video (owner)

tasks.description: After the recording, the owner types /prose on README.md and docs/ so the judge-facing text reads as written by the person who did the work, then merges its changes.

steps: Type /prose on README.md and docs/ in the product repository.
Merge its changes (conventional commit), then reply « fait ».

expect.summary: the owner confirms the /prose pass

negative_control.description: an owner action
negative_control.waived_reason: an owner action, nothing to falsify by script

tasks.title: Run /prose on the README and docs (owner)

tasks.description: Take the README screenshots of the final UI (headless when Windows is not activated), store them under docs/screenshots/ and reference them from README.md. Last code change before the docs freeze and the tag.

tasks.title: README screenshots, last

tasks.description: The owner fills the submission form with the repository link, the video and the deck, and keeps the confirmation.

steps: Fill the submission form with the repository link, the video and the deck.
Reply « soumis » with the confirmation text or link.

expect.summary: the owner confirms the submission

negative_control.description: an owner deliverable
negative_control.waived_reason: an owner deliverable, nothing to falsify by script

tasks.title: Submit the form (owner)

tasks.description: Write RELEASE.md (the tag name, the submitted commit's date and what it contains), land it through exec.py merge, then tag the landed commit submission with an annotated tag and push the tag (never a force push). Before the push freeze.

expect.summary: the tag points at the landed commit

negative_control.description: before the tag task, the tag does not exist: the proof fails

spec.cmd: test -f RELEASE.md && test "$(git rev-parse 'submission^{commit}')" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"

tasks.title: Tag the submitted commit

tasks.description: At the docs freeze, check that no commit after the freeze instant touches README.md,docs/**; the README screenshots land before it.

expect.summary: no commit after the freeze instant touches the frozen globs

negative_control.description: a forged commit dated after the freeze that touches a frozen glob must exit 1

expect.summary: no commit after the push freeze

negative_control.description: a forged commit dated after the freeze must exit 1
